agent.finish_summary: Fixed a case-sensitivity bug in sqlparse/engine/grouping.py's group_functions(): the has_as flag (used together with has_create/has_table to decide whether to skip function-grouping for CREATE TABLE statements) was compared with an exact-case '== AS' check while the sibling has_create/has_table checks used case-insensitive .upper() comparisons. This meant CREATE TABLE ... as SELECT func() ... (lowercase/mixed-case AS) incorrectly triggered the skip-grouping guard, so functions in the SELECT part of a CREATE TABLE AS SELECT statement were not grouped into sql.Function when AS wasn't all-uppercase. Changed the has_as check to tmp_token.value.upper() == 'AS' for consistency. Verified via manual parse-tree dumps that CREATE TABLE ... as/AS/As SELECT func() ..., plain CREATE TABLE with function defaults, and bare function calls all now group correctly and consistently.
